title: Closure of a Lift Ticket Order Record
content:
A Lift Tickets order record is closed only when nothing is left to collect on it and no ticket credit issued on it is left to spend. Both conditions are read from the collective's own record of that order, before it is closed and against the order itself: the amount still to be collected, and the ticket credit standing against it. Closing is the last entry made on the record, and nothing is added to it afterwards.

## Points of judgement

**An order with nothing left to collect, but ticket credit still standing against it.** Not yet closed. The rule requires both conditions together.

**An order whose credit has all been spent, but on which an amount is still to be collected.** Not yet closed, for the same reason.

**An order with nothing to collect and no credit left to spend.** The two conditions for closing are met.

**Does closing put an end to credit issued on the order?** No. Ticket credit issued against a closed order keeps its own validity period, and is spent against a later order.

**Is anything ever added to a closed record?** No. Closing is the last entry made on it.
